import pytest
from doorstop import settings
from doorstop.core import build, Item, Tree, Document, Item
from doorstop.common import DoorstopError

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Helper utilities
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def _create_temp_tree(tmp_path):
    """Create a minimal tree with a single document for testing."""
    # Create a dummy document file
    doc_path = tmp_path / "doc.md"
    doc_path.write_text("# Test Document\n\n")
    # Build the tree
    tree = build(cwd=str(tmp_path))
    return tree, doc_path

# Test cases

    # Attempt to create a new item without specifying an ID
    item = Item(text="New Requirement Text")
    tree.add(item)
    assert item.uid is not None, "Item should have a generated UID"
